categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes wallet initialization and database cleanup logic in `src/wallet/wallet.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled exception that aborts the GUI process when external signer wallet creation fails and cleans up orphaned database files that block retry. As noted in the description, on master an uncaught `std::runtime_error` terminates the process and leaves behind partial wallet files that cause subsequent creation attempts to fail with 'Database already exists'.
